description: This file contains implementation details for the PyTorch profiler, including classes and functions for collecting, processing, and exporting profiling data, as well as integration with Kineto for GPU profiling and trace management.

classes.name: TransferEvents
classes.description: Handles the transfer and association of Kineto trace activities with profiler results, including linking forward and backward operations and managing trace extraction.

methods.name: Result::name
methods.description: Returns the name of the profiling result, formatted based on the event type.

methods.name: Result::overload_name
methods.description: Returns the overload name for TorchOp events.

methods.name: Result::kinetoType
methods.description: Returns the Kineto activity type corresponding to the result.

methods.name: Result::correlationID
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the result.

methods.name: Result::endTimeNS
methods.description: Calculates and returns the end time of the result in nanoseconds.

methods.name: Result::endTID
methods.description: Returns the thread ID where the result ended.

methods.name: Result::deviceType
methods.description: Returns the device type associated with the result.

methods.name: RecordQueue::getRecords
methods.description: Collects and returns profiling results and optional Kineto trace within a specified time window.

methods.name: RecordQueue::getSubqueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a thread-local subqueue for profiling data collection.

methods.name: RecordQueue::stop
methods.description: Stops the Python tracer if active.

methods.name: RecordQueue::restart
methods.description: Restarts the Python tracer if active.
